agent/tools.py (symbols; reachability, run_cypher, live_app_status, data_exposure, probe_endpoints, plan_fix, verify_fix, apply_dependency_fix, open_pull_request, record_triage_decision, past_decisions)

implemented_capabilities.capability: Python and JS/TS source parsing into a function call graph with HTTP entrypoint discovery
implemented_capabilities.notes: Uses ast for Python (FastAPI router prefixes/includes, Depends chains, Django route normalization, inherited deps) and tree-sitter for JS/TS (Next routes, Express-style). Call edges carry a 'how' label (self/import/local/unique/name-match/Depends); name-match edges are flagged lower confidence. Heuristic static analysis, not a type-resolved call graph.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Dependency inventory from lockfiles and OSV vulnerability enrichment
implemented_capabilities.notes: Parses poetry/uv/requirements/npm/yarn/pnpm lockfiles into Package nodes and DEPENDS_ON edges and queries OSV for advisories with fixed versions and CVSS severity (cached HTTP). Needs outbound network to OSV.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Vulnerability reachability / blast radius from public endpoint to vulnerable package sink with call path and confidence
implemented_capabilities.notes: Cypher variable-length path MATCH (h)-[:CALLS*0..N]->(sink)-[:USES]->(Package) joined to EXPOSES->Entrypoint, ranked by live/auth/confidence/hops; choke points via path-count aggregation plus FalkorDB algo.betweenness / algo.pageRank; impact radius via algo.BFS; shortest paths via algo.SPpaths. N hops are clamped to 0..6 before f-string interpolation.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Live deployment vs code drift (OpenAPI/GraphQL/JS-bundle discovery, optional LLM endpoint extraction)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Compares the Entrypoints declared in code with those the deployed app exposes (live, openapi-only, only_in_code, live_unauthenticated counts), flags unknown-auth sensitive paths, and can send benign HEAD/GET/OPTIONS probes. Relies on regex/LLM extraction from minified bundles for non-OpenAPI sites (best-effort).
Batches (500) UNWIND/MERGE loads of Repo/File/Function/Class/Package/Vulnerability/Commit/Author/Table nodes; author email is hashed to an id.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Claude triage agent with write-back memory, fix planning, branch commit and PR creation
implemented_capabilities.notes: Manual tool-use loop (model name taken from BLAST_MODEL env) with every step traced; decisions are persisted as (:Vulnerability)-[:TRIAGED]->(:Decision {status,reason,decided_at,by}) with fixed status enum and consulted in later sessions. The fix tool edits pyproject/requirements/package.json via regex and commits on a new branch of the analysed repo; PR creation needs GITHUB_TOKEN and a fork.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Web UI with graph visualisation, run replay ('story mode') and report export
implemented_capabilities.notes: Single-file HTML UI with vendored cytoscape.min.js and marked.min.js; SSE-style ingest streaming; self-contained replay pages.

graph_models_and_cypher: One graph per analysed repo. Nodes: Repo, File, Class, Function, Entrypoint, Package, Vulnerability, Commit, Author, Decision, Table. Edges: CONTAINS, HAS_METHOD, CALLS{how}, EXPOSES, USES, IMPORTS, DEPENDS_ON, AFFECTS{installed_version,fixed_version}, MODIFIED, AUTHORED, OWNS{lines,share,last_touched}, TRIAGED, DEFINES, TOUCHES. Documented in docs/queries.md (12 query families). Reads use GRAPH.RO_QUERY ($params); the only write tool is record_triage_decision plus the bulk loaders. FalkorDB-native procedures used: algo.SPpaths, algo.betweenness, algo.pageRank, algo.BFS, db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes - all FalkorDB-specific (no APOC/GDS). NOTE: algo.SPpaths is used on call graphs; LastLift's docs report SPpaths on FalkorDB 4.22.0 can run for hours and ignore query timeouts, so shortest_attack_paths is a risk on Kairos' 4.22 server (requirements pin FalkorDB==1.7.1; compose uses falkordb/falkordb:latest).
algorithms: Bounded variable-length call-path reachability (CALLS*0..N, N<=6) with edge-resolution confidence in agent/tools.py:GraphTools.reachability
Choke-point ranking by endpoints-per-function path aggregation plus algo.betweenness/algo.pageRank in GraphTools.choke_points
algo.BFS bounded impact radius in GraphTools.impact_radius
Fixed-version selection as max(Version(fixed)) across advisories in GraphTools.plan_fix
Rolling git-blame ownership shares per function in ingest/git_history.py:ownership
Code-vs-deployment route set comparison (norm_path normalisation) in ingest/discover.py and server/app.py:discover_live
backend_interfaces: FastAPI server/app.py: GET /, /api/health, /api/overview, /api/funnel, POST /api/discover, GET /api/graphs, POST /api/graph/select, POST /api/upload, POST /api/analyze, GET /api/feed, /api/graph/seed, /api/endpoint, /api/graph/neighborhood, POST /api/ask, GET /api/report/{run_id}, /replay/{run_id}, /api/cypher
MCP stdio server agent/mcp_server.py exposing every GraphTools method (usable from Claude Desktop/Code)
CLI: python -m agent.cli, python -m ingest.run, Makefile targets

agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Claude tool-use loop (manual, traced) that selects tools through the project's own MCP server or in-process; persistent graph memory via Decision nodes (EXPLOITABLE/NOT_REACHABLE/MITIGATED/NEEDS_REVIEW/FIX_PROPOSED) read back by past_decisions so later sessions build on earlier triage. Sessions are held in an in-process SESSIONS dict.
tests_present: tests/test_parse.py - a single parser unit test on a synthetic FastAPI project (1 test); tests/scenarios.py is a live agent scenario runner that needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and a FalkorDB with the mealie graph. No unit tests for the Cypher, tools or drift logic. Not executed by auditor.
security_findings: server/app.py:537-542 - GET /api/cypher runs caller-supplied Cypher via ro_query with no authentication; server-enforced read-only, but arbitrary reads and expensive queries (DoS) of any loaded graph.
agent/tools.py:193-199 - run_cypher tool uses a regex denylist for write keywords and runs through ro_query (server-side read-only), so the denylist is defence-in-depth rather than the only barrier.
agent/tools.py:93-100 - Cypher built with f-string for the hop bound; value is clamped with max(0, min(int(max_hops), 6)) before use. Package/endpoint values are $params.

agent/mcp_server.py:56 - exec(_src, _ns) to synthesise typed MCP tool functions from TOOL_DEFS (name/description/parameter names come from static in-repo definitions, not from user input); a description containing triple quotes would break the generated source.

agent/tools.py:255-283 - probe_endpoints performs outbound HTTP to a stored live URL and is gated only by an LLM-supplied boolean i_am_authorized (model can self-attest); sleeps 0.3s, max 15 endpoints.

server/app.py:129-165 and ingest/discover.py - POST /api/discover fetches an arbitrary user-supplied http(s) URL plus up to 14 scripts/16 MB (SSRF to internal hosts is not blocked; only github/gitlab hosts are special-cased).

server/app.py:311-338 - /api/upload extracts an uploaded zip (checks '..' / absolute names and 2 GB total size) then runs git commands (git init/add/commit, and ingest runs git blame/log) inside it; an uploaded repo containing a crafted .git directory/config could execute attacker-chosen commands (e.g. core.fsmonitor), and the destination is rmtree'd if it already exists.
agent/tools.py:371-423 - apply_dependency_fix rewrites files in the analysed repo via regex and creates/commits a branch (subprocess git with list args, no shell).

agent/tools.py:426-447 - open_pull_request embeds GITHUB_TOKEN in the git remote URL (x-access-token:...@github.com) and force-pushes (-f); token is scrubbed from stderr output but is visible in the process argument list.
docker-compose.yml - publishes FalkorDB 6379 and 3000 on all interfaces with no password and image tag 'latest'.
No hard-coded secrets found; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / GITHUB_TOKEN come from env. server/app.py has no CORS or auth middleware found by grep.
duplicates_or_overlaps: Core overlap with the 'blast-radius traversal' family (function-level call graph + dependency reachability), attack-path / choke-point analysis and CVE triage; also overlaps Reet24-del/supply-chain-blast-radius in this batch (package-level only) and the generic reverse-DEPENDS_ON BFS found in other entries.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - live-vs-code Entrypoint drift counts, confidence-labelled call edges, advisory fixed_version tracking and persisted TRIAGED Decision records with timestamps give a working 'conclusion memory', but decisions are not invalidated when the underlying code/advisory changes and nothing is versioned or superseded.

strongest_reusable_unit.file: agent/tools.py (reachability / choke_points / impact_radius) with ingest/parse_python.py and ingest/deps.py
strongest_reusable_unit.why: A working end-to-end pipeline from lockfile + AST into a graph and a documented set of Cypher queries (docs/queries.md) for advisory -> package -> function -> endpoint reachability with call-path confidence, plus a persisted triage-decision memory. ingest/deps.py lockfile parsers are pure Python and independently reusable.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (algo.BFS/betweenness/pageRank/SPpaths); OSV.dev network; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY only for the agent; git for ownership

strategy_rationale: Fits a Software Dependency Intelligence pack inside Kairos: reuse the parsers, loaders and documented Cypher, but gate or replace algo.SPpaths for FalkorDB 4.22, harden the unauthenticated /api/cypher, /api/discover and upload paths, and swap the Claude loop for Kairos' own agent layer.
